## Spending & Budget — pending data

This dashboard depends on `fin_transactions` and `fin_budgets`, which haven't been migrated into the toolyard lake yet. Once the migration agent lands `raw.transactions` and `raw.budgets` (or matching `mart.*` views), re-run `deploy/grafana/build_dashboards.py` to rebuild this dashboard with the real panels.

In the meantime, `Finance Overview (lake)` and `Investment Portfolio (lake)` are fully populated against the existing lake tables.
